messages:
helen (Design): quick design pass from me — a few behavior and copy things in the routing policies editor i noticed while testing the preview simulator. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/routing-editor
nate (PM): thanks! want to catch the priority ordering bugs first — heard reorder can flip rules unexpectedly after save?
kai (FE): saw that on staging. repro: drag rule 3 above rule 1, click save, UI shows new order but backend returns original order on reload. suspect optimistic UI + ordering key mismatch.
helen (Design): question: keep optimistic ordering or lock until server confirms? i lean lock-with-spinner for accessibility/clarity — otherwise keyboard users get confused.
sofia (A11y): +1 for lock. keyboard reordering needs an accessible pattern: up/down move buttons with aria-live notifications ("Moved rule 3 to position 1"). current live region is missing.
kai (FE): can add move buttons and aria-live, but preview updates still won't be announced for screen readers.
sofia (A11y): announce preview simulator updates. use role="status" and concise messages: "Preview updated: traffic routed to model-alpha." keep messages under 80 chars.
helen (Design): copy tweaks: replace "Priority" label with "Priority (higher = applied first)" to help new users.
mika (QE): found validation hole: weights allow floats and sum isn't validated client-side. backend rejects >100 but UX shows vague toast "Validation failed". need inline error: "Total weight cannot exceed 100%" and highlight the sum row.
kai (FE): will add client-side sum check + red outline + error tooltip. tooltip copy: "Weights total 105% — reduce values so total ≤ 100%."
helen (Design): empty state microcopy: change "Add a rule" to "No rules yet — add a routing rule to start routing traffic." small but boosts discoverability.
sofia (A11y): contrast nit: disabled "Simulate" button at ~16% contrast on light theme. needs 3:1 per AA for components. prefer token `gray-600` instead of `gray-400` for disabled.
helen (Design): preview sim behavior: switching dev→prod models wipes user input. propose preserving input across model switches and showing a subtle banner: "Input preserved while switching models" with dismiss and a "reset input" affordance.
nate (PM): product: persist per-route or global? prefer per-route so teams test different prompts per policy.
helen (Design): agree per-route. implementation note: localStorage keyed by route_id with 7d TTL.
kai (FE): implementation plan noted. also: after saving reorder, focus should land on the moved rule (current behavior jumps to top). will fix focus management.
sofia (A11y): ensure draggable handles are keyboard focusable and have aria-labels like "Grab to reorder rule: <rule name>". also add visible focus ring for selected rule.
mika (QE): regression items: reorder E2E, aria announcement checks, client-side weight validation. i'll add tests to CI.
design-bot: staging build deployed: staging-2026-03-21-rc4 :rocket:
kai (FE): i'll open a PR for move buttons + client validation tonight, tagging @sofia for aria message review.
sofia (A11y): i'll review tomorrow morning. please add a short checklist in PR desc for screen reader QA.
helen (Design): tiny final copy tweak: change "Apply changes" to "Save changes" and make hover state 2px darker to improve affordance. thanks! :heart:
nate (PM): prioritized backlog: 1) lock-on-reorder + spinner, 2) aria announcements, 3) client-side weight check, 4) disabled contrast fix, 5) preview input persistence. sync meeting 11:00am.
